artwork.title: 青碧晨雾
artwork.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: premium macOS app icon exploration, one standalone original raster object.
Create ONE exquisite crystal-clear water droplet containing an immortal Chinese mountain world, a tiny realm inside a single drop, evoking Fangcun Mountain. The silhouette is the top priority: a broad almost circular water pearl with just a TINY SHORT SOFTLY POINTED crest at the top. Overall outer width-to-height ratio 1:1.08. The small point occupies only 6–8% of total height; almost all the silhouette is a round orb. Absolutely NO elongated teardrop neck or tall triangular pointed upper section.
Composition: square transparent canvas; sole droplet optically centered in both dimensions, occupying about 80% of canvas height, balanced even margins. Front view, polished luxury 3D icon render, fine elegant details and an immediately readable broad form at 64 pixels.
Within the transparent round droplet: ONE majestic jade-green Chinese sacred mountain rising from a soft white morning cloud sea. Cloud ribbons wrap and veil the emerald slopes; mist gives real depth. A very small ancient Chinese pavilion roof can sit on a distant ridge as a subtle sense of scale, not the focal point. A pale golden dawn glint touches the peaks. Palette: luminous jade emerald, clear cyan, pearly white and restrained pale gold. Serene, fresh, magical, luminous rather than dark.
Materials: truly aqueous rounded smooth liquid surface, believable curved optical refraction, delicate pearly rim and controlled small specular highlights, enough visibly transparent water around the miniature mountain to read as a world enclosed in a drop. Avoid a thick plastic or faceted crystal appearance.
The entire mountain and all mist are enclosed by the water silhouette. The exterior is genuinely transparent alpha with no scenery, shadow floor or backdrop. No square app backing, no lettering, no Chinese characters, no words, no logos, no watermark, no decorative border, no stand, no base, no splash, no extra droplets, no faceted gemstone. Deliver one single centered near-round short-tip droplet, not a sheet of options.
